title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive

Leicestershire

Salary: Up to £35,000 + Annual Profit Related Bonus

Permanent, Full-Time

Hybrid Working

Are you an experienced Business Development Manager in the construction industry with a strong background in consultative sales and a proven track record of winning new business?

Regional Recruitment are recruiting for a Business Development Executive to join a growing construction business based in Leicestershire. This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced sales professional who enjoys developing new business, building strong customer relationships.

Working within a specialist construction environment, you will be responsible for building a strong pipeline of new business, promoting bespoke and tailor-made products and solutions, managing client relationships and identifying opportunities for future growth.

A key part of the role will involve lead generation, arranging site surveys for senior sales staff and working alongside the survey, projects and tendering teams to ensure accurate proposals and quotations are produced.

If you are a commercially driven sales professional looking for an internal sales role within the construction industry then this role could be for you!

What's on Offer:
- Salary of up to £35,000 DOE
- Annual profit related bonus
- Hybrid working
- Full-time, permanent position
- Office based in Leicestershire
- Opportunity to join a growing business
- The chance to play a key role in driving the company's future growth

Qualifications

Essential:
- Proven experience in a Business Development or sales role within the construction industry
- Strong track record of generating and winning new business
- Excellent relationship-building and communication skills
- Proven ability to manage a sales pipeline and convert opportunities into revenue
- Strong commercial awareness and negotiation skills

Desirable:
- Experience selling bespoke, project-based products or services
- Experience working alongside project, surveying or tendering teams
- Experience using CRM systems

Roles & Responsibilities
- Develop and execute a proactive business development strategy to generate new opportunities and build a strong pipeline of future business
- Identify and target new customers across relevant sectors and markets
- Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients and key decision makers
- Take a consultative approach to sales, understanding client requirements and identifying the most appropriate bespoke solutions
- Arrange site surveys for senior sales staff
- Work closely with the survey, projects and tendering teams to ensure accurate and commercially viable quotations are produced
- Present proposals and solutions to clients, confidently handling questions and objections throughout the sales process
- Maintain a strong and accurate sales pipeline through effective CRM management
- Monitor and follow up on live opportunities to maximise conversion rates
- Develop existing customer relationships to identify opportunities for repeat business and further growth
- Support marketing and lead generation activity to increase the company's reach within target markets
- Research market trends, competitors and potential customers to identify new opportunities
- Report on pipeline activity, opportunities and sales performance to senior management

Requirements

As Business Development Executive, you will also be expected to:
- Be commercially driven with a genuine passion for winning new business
- Be confident managing conversations with senior decision makers and key stakeholders
- Be proactive in building and maintaining a strong sales pipeline
- Be highly organised with the ability to manage multiple projects and opportunities at different stages
- Have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
- Be comfortable working collaboratively with survey, project and tendering teams
- Be motivated by achieving business growth and delivering results

About Regional Recruitment

This position is being advertised by Regional Recruitment Ltd, an award-winning independent recruitment agency established in 2008. We specialise in permanent, temporary, and contract opportunities across the Commercial, Construction, Industrial, Technology, and Engineering sectors.

title: Internal Sales and Applications Engineer
description:
Internal Sales and Applications Engineer

Leicester

c 35k - 38k neg dep exp

Our client has been established for more than a century and are recognised as global market leaders in the design and manufacture of niche electrical solutions, and as a result of continued success and an ongoing programme of strategic growth, are now seeking to recruit an experienced and enthusiastic Internal Sales and Applications Engineer to complement their professional technical Sales team.

Based in Enderby in Leicester and reporting to the Sales Director, the successful Internal Sales and Applications Engineer candidate will become a key member of the Sales team and act as the front-line contact for customers, developing and maintaining strong relationships as well as dealing with often complex technical enquiries and processing orders. You will be tasked with understanding customer technical requirements, identifying appropriate solutions and producing preliminary designs which can be costed and quoted and will generate profitable business for the company, with the role operating as the interface between Customers and the Contracts/Engineering teams, demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of the whole portfolio of company products.

Core duties for this varied and challenging Internal Sales and Applications Engineer role will include (but not be limited to):
- Processing customer enquiries, including initial customer contact via telephone, email, and face to face as well as occasionally undertaking on-site customer visits.
- Managing, understanding and interpreting customer requirements, before producing designs and costed solutions to satisfy these requirements, whilst maximising the benefit for the company
- Production of quotations/tenders in a timely, clear, detailed and accurate manner
- Following up quotations in a timely manner to secure profitable orders
- Maintaining your expert level of product knowledge and applications
- Providing pre-sales technical expertise and product education to new and existing customers
- Ensuring orders are processed quickly and that information allowing for design and manufacturing is passed to the relevant department
- Ensuring customers are kept informed of order (contract) status and that any issues are resolved quickly
- Maintaining accurate up-to-date records of enquiries, quotations, orders and activity
- Pursuing new business opportunities where identified and supporting the fellow Contracts, Engineering and Production departments, and building relationships with both new and existing customers in order to understand their requirements.

To be considered for this exceptional Internal Sales and Applications Engineer opportunity within a market leading global manufacturing and supply environment, it is envisaged the successful candidate will demonstrate at least 2 years' experience in an electrical or technical sales or applications engineering position having dealt with large OEM's or international customers and realistically be qualified to HNC level or above (or QBE) in an electrical, electronic or controls engineering discipline, with knowledge of MV and HV systems, batteries and generators proving distinctly advantageous. You will have strong IT skills and be proficient in the MS suite of packages, with a solid technical mindset - able to read and interpret technical data and relay this accurately to others.

Contact the Electrical Team at Premier Technical Recruitment on (phone number removed) or email your cv in confidence to (url removed) for further details.

title: Internal Sales Executive
company: BPX Electro Mechanical Co Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
We have a new and exciting opportunity for an Internal Sales Executive to join our team at our branch located in Leicester (LE7 7 NL). We are looking for a bright, enthusiastic person to join our friendly team. This is a full-time, permanent position, where continuous sales development and training will be provided.

About Us

For 60 years BPX (part of the RS Group) has built a reputation as the leading independent distributor of factory automation and control components - from computers to connectors, from robots to relays and everything in between. We now employ over 180 people and from our 15 locations throughout the UK & Ireland, we provide a local service to our customers.

Our continued success comes from our passion for technology and commitment to customer service. We are a talented group across our UK and Ireland branch network and work towards our mission for our customers, "help to choose, help to use".

BPX are the strategic partner to market leading brands such as Schneider Electric, Mitsubishi, Omron and many more, offering innovative products, solutions and technical support to thousands of customers UK wide.

Job purpose

As a member of our team, you will be responsible for handling customer enquiries, liaising with suppliers and ensuring that our clients receive the highest level of service. By utilising your excellent interpersonal skills, you will develop long-term relationships with our customers ensuring that their requirements and business needs are interpreted and handled quickly and effectively.

The main duties will include:

Answer incoming enquiries to sell and support the company product range.

Proactively make outgoing calls qualifying prospects and closing sales in order to meet targets.

Accurately process quotations and sales orders using in house systems.

Timely administration of quotations using in house quotation software.

Ensure customer records are updated frequently and accurately on the Customer Relationship Management Software.

Collation of customer files and purchase orders to company standards.

Interact with customers to resolve any queries or issues.

Provide feedback to the sales team on newly emerging opportunities, proactively assisting as required.

Maintain culture of continuous improvement and excellence in customer service.

Collate and co-ordinate information requested for management purposes.

Any other ad hoc duties required by the Branch Manager.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

To join our team, we are looking for a person who has the following:

A proactive/can do attitude towards helping the business grow.

A proven track record within an internal sales role.

Experience of making proactive outgoing telephone calls.

A passion for sales.

Excellent customer interaction skills.

Strong organisational, administrative and telephone skills.

Ability to prioritise work, meet deadlines and follow through on commitments.

Excellent attention to detail such that customer orders and information are accurate.

Confident telephone manner.

Computer literate (MS Office).

Industrial Automation and Control knowledge desired but not essential (training provided).

Full UK driving licence

BPX offers great benefits such as:

Minimum of 31 days annual leave including bank holidays (increasing with length of service)

Access to our training and development platform

Friendly and supportive work environment

Dress down Fridays

Access to the Employee Assistance Programme

Recruitment referral bonus

Opportunities for career progression

Cycle 2 Work scheme

Ability to carry forward unused holiday

Option to purchase additional annual leave

Free onsite parking

Emergency loans

BPX remains a financially secure business, offering the chance to work within a happy, friendly company with some wonderful and talented people.

If you like a challenge and believe you are the right person to join our team, please click apply and upload your CV, we look forward to hearing from you!

We reserve the right to close the advert early when a suitable candidate is found.

No Agencies, please.

title: Internal Sales Representative - Lighting
description:
Internal Sales Representative - Lighting

Location: Beaumont Leys, Leicester (office-based)

Salary: Depending on experience + Discretionary bonus

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 08:00 - 17:00

Established distributor supplying lighting products to the UK's electrical wholesale market is looking for an enthusiastic Internal Sales Executive to join the team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with sales or customer service experience who enjoys building strong customer relationships, delivering outstanding service, and contributing directly to business growth. As the first point of contact for many of our customers, you'll play a vital role in converting enquiries into orders and helping us maintain our reputation for excellent service.

- Responding to customer enquiries via phone, email, and online channels.
- Providing product information, pricing, and availability updates.
- Preparing accurate and competitive quotations tailored to customer requirements.
- Following up quotations to maximise sales opportunities and secure orders.
- Processing customer orders accurately and efficiently.
- Booking supplier deliveries into the ERP system.
- Coordinating with warehouse and logistics teams to ensure on-time dispatch.
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with new and existing customers.
- Supporting the external sales team with reporting, lead tracking, and administration.
- Keeping CRM records up to date and maintaining accurate sales activity data.

- At least 1-2 years' experience in a sales, customer service, internal sales, or similar role.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational and time-management abilities.
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Confident using Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- A proactive, customer-focused approach with a willingness to learn.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable
- Experience within the lighting, electrical wholesale, or electrical products sector.
- Previous experience using CRM and ERP systems.

What We Offer
- Salary DOE

- Annual leave increases by 1 day per year of service, up to 25 days plus bank holidays

- Employee discount
- Free on-site parking

- Supportive and friendly working environment

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Coordinator

Location: Leicester
Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time
Pay: From 12.71 per hour

365 People are recruiting for an established Leicester-based business looking for a Customer Service Coordinator to join their friendly and growing team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a career in customer service and sales support.

You do not need years of experience for this position. You may already have some customer service, administration or sales experience, but we are equally interested in people with transferable skills who are confident communicating with customers and keen to learn.

Full training will be provided on the company's products, systems and processes.

The Role

You'll become part of a close-working team responsible for looking after customers and helping enquiries and orders run smoothly.

Your duties will include:
- Speaking with customers by telephone and email
- Handling incoming enquiries
- Preparing quotations and following them up
- Processing and monitoring customer orders
- Keeping customers updated on progress
- Building relationships with regular customers
- Following up enquiries and potential opportunities
- Liaising with colleagues and other departments
- Helping resolve customer queries
- Keeping customer and order information up to date
- Providing general sales and administration support
- Learning the company's products and services
- Taking on additional responsibility as your confidence develops

Who We're Looking For

We're more interested in finding the right person than somebody who ticks every box on a CV.

You could currently be working in customer service, administration, retail, hospitality, sales or another customer-facing environment and be looking for an opportunity to move into an office-based commercial role.

We'd like somebody who:
- Is friendly, approachable and comfortable speaking to people
- Has a good telephone manner
- Communicates clearly
- Is organised and reliable
- Is comfortable using a computer
- Is willing to learn
- Will follow things up and take ownership
- Enjoys working as part of a team
- Takes pride in providing good customer service
- Wants to develop and progress

Previous office-based customer service, sales administration or internal sales experience would be useful, but it isn't essential.

Experience within manufacturing, signage, print or a similar environment would also be helpful, but again is not required.

Why Apply?

This isn't a role where you're expected to arrive knowing everything.

You'll be supported while you learn the business and its products, with the opportunity to develop your customer service and commercial skills and gradually take on more responsibility.

If you're personable, switched on and willing to get involved, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV for immediate consideration.
